name: Rubik's Crystal Cube 3x3
description: See the cube like never before. The Rubik’s Crystal Cube 3x3 gives the classic puzzle a brilliant transparent twist, letting you see straight into the heart of the cube as you solve. With six translucent colors and smooth, durable construction, it’s both a display-worthy collectible and a fun challenge for cubers of any skill level.
features: Transparent Design: Clear body and crystal-colored sides let you see the cube’s inner mechanism as you turn.
Iconic Challenge: Classic 3×3 format with over 43 quintillion possible combinations.
Perfect for All Levels: Great for beginners learning to solve or experts adding something unique to their collection.
Smooth Turning: Built with modern internals for a reliable, satisfying feel.
Display-Ready: Eye-catching and unique — a standout piece for any puzzle shelf.
